purpose: Outcome-blind qualification of a genuinely new FCP spatial cohort targeted to CHUN temporal clades.

fcp_source.candidate_frame_definition: U100 species after exclusion of the 1000 legacy discovery/reserve species and the earlier 500 P500 prospective selections.

taxonomic_crosswalk.rule: Exact first-token genus match between FCP species string and one of the 28 frozen CHUN common-frame clade names.

qualification.rationale: At least 12 independent radiation-level units are required before a cross-clade association is worth opening; at least five fresh spatially sampled species per clade are required for a stable clade-level median response. This is a feasibility threshold, not a power guarantee.

selection.ordering: Within each qualifying clade, ascending SHA256(salt|inat_taxon_id|species), then integer inat_taxon_id.

future_primary_test.predictor: temporal_turnover = -1 * frozen CHUN fine_slope; higher values mean faster loss of exact fine-colour excess retention with relative divergence.
future_primary_test.response: Median fresh-species FCP spatial_rho within each selected clade, estimated with the already validated species-conditioned FCP spatial metric from newly sampled images.
future_primary_test.hypothesis: Faster evolutionary turnover predicts stronger contemporary geographic colour organization.
future_primary_test.aggregation: One median spatial_rho per clade; species are not treated as independent temporal replicates.
future_primary_test.outcome_opening_rule: Do not compute the temporal-turnover/spatial-organization association until the fresh image cohort has been selected, measured and terminalized under its own frozen FCP acquisition/measurement contract.

current_existing_bridge.role: feasibility diagnostic only, not the future primary test
current_existing_bridge.reason: Existing validation overlap is too sparse for a defensible radiation-level bridge.
